brand.name: Smart Mount
brand.what: TV wall mounting and installation, done fast and clean: perfectly level, wires hidden, no mess
brand.proof: 4.8 stars on Google, hundreds of installs
brand.audience: homeowners and renters who just bought a big TV and dread drilling into their wall

idea: Treat a TV install like an action-movie heist: a calm pro arrives, tools come out like weapons, the drill bites, the bracket locks, the TV glides onto the wall in slow motion, wires vanish, and the family drops onto the couch for movie night. Satisfying, funny, confident.
notes: Characters invented (an installer, a young family). No real people. The TV screen shows soft abstract colour, never text or recognisable content. No text or logos generated anywhere.
